Field Label:
Stemmer Sign

Performing the Stemmer Sign test: Perform test while participant is seated with feet on the ground. Examiner pinches the dorsal skin proximal to the MTP joint of the second toe (or MCP joint of the second finger).

If the examiner cannot create a fold of pinched skin, this results in a positive sign. If you cannot pinch, the Stemmer sign is positive, and Lymphedema is likely present.

If you can pinch, the Stemmer sign is negative, and Lymphedema is likely not present.
Choices, Calculations, OR Slider Labels: 1, Positive Stemmer Sign | 0, Negative Stemmer Sign
1, Yes | 0, No

Field Label:
Stemmer Sign

Performing the Stemmer Sign test: Perform test while participant is seated with feet on the ground. Examiner pinches the dorsal skin proximal to the MTP joint of the second toe (or MCP joint of the second finger).

If the examiner cannot create a fold of pinched skin, this results in a positive sign. If you cannot pinch, the Stemmer sign is positive, and Lymphedema is likely present.

If you can pinch, the Stemmer sign is negative, and Lymphedema is likely not present.

Field Label:
Stemmer Sign

Performing the Stemmer Sign test: Perform test while participant is seated with feet on the ground. Examiner pinches the dorsal skin proximal to the MTP joint of the second toe (or MCP joint of the second finger).

If the examiner cannot create a fold of pinched skin, this results in a positive sign. If you cannot pinch, the Stemmer sign is positive, and Lymphedema is likely present.

If you can pinch, the Stemmer sign is negative, and Lymphedema is likely not present.

Field Label:
Stemmer Sign

Performing the Stemmer Sign test: Perform test while participant is seated with feet on the ground. Examiner pinches the dorsal skin proximal to the MTP joint of the second toe (or MCP joint of the second finger).

If the examiner cannot create a fold of pinched skin, this results in a positive sign. If you cannot pinch, the Stemmer sign is positive, and Lymphedema is likely present.

If you can pinch, the Stemmer sign is negative, and Lymphedema is likely not present.
Choices, Calculations, OR Slider Labels: 1, Positive Stemmer Sign | 0, Negative Stemmer Sign
